scope: U02 time-control semantics and L04 journey selection, continuation and URL history

requirements.decision: Moving the shared slider previews a year locally. Explore commits that year to navigation history. The preview status identifies the draft and its commit action in both timeline and world views.
checks: At 390 by 844, keyboard slider movement from 200 CE to 201 CE updates the draft and regional heading while retaining the committed URL.
Explore commits 201 CE. Browser Back restores 200 CE and Forward restores 201 CE, including the slider value.
One expansion exposes direct year entry. Entering year zero produces an error and preserves the chosen year.
Direct entry reaches 1 BCE. Next year reaches 1 CE and Previous year returns to 1 BCE.
Full history is visible outside the collapsed refinement control and opens the proportional 3300 BCE to 2000 CE slider with one activation.
The root navigation implementation exposes the selected region and preserves focus and history separately; its additional receipts document those checks.

decisions: Filters use compact, validated optional URL parameters and retain established default URLs. Search edits replace the current history entry; dropdown changes and clearing filters create navigable entries.
The period selector shows each chapter's actual start and end years. Region matching uses any route stop, and duration matching uses the upper end of the stated estimate.

Family eligibility derives from authored family evidence tasks or existing chapter activities. All 33 current journeys have family evidence tasks, so both tracks currently offer 33 routes. Synthetic adult-only and unknown-duration cases exercise exclusion behavior.
Family-track cards link the 33 existing family source activity PDFs. This classification describes available material; observed-reader age testing was removed from project scope by the user.
Continuation retains the active library filters and returns to that library scope. Theme links retain the same scope and support browser Back.
Reading reset removes the local reading position and preserves notebook entries.
checks: Three introductory activities appear initially; the existing expansion offers all eight.
Actual combined search, C1 period, South Asia region, up-to-40-minute duration and family track results match the underlying route records.
Reload restores every selected filter. Opening a route, moving to stop two, returning to the library and continuing restores the same journey, stop, subject and year.
Clear filters returns all 33 routes. Back restores the previous filter choices and Forward clears them again.
THEME01 returns its three authored routes; opening its first subject and returning preserves the theme filter.
Reset removes the resume key and the continuation controls. A zero-result search has an explicit message and Clear filters restores results.
A 527-pixel intrinsic period selector initially overflowed the 390-pixel page. A minimum-width correction fixes the control; the final full-page overflow assertion passes.
